info.prompt: A cyber-alchemical laboratory table where dice carved from translucent amber float above a neural lattice of crackling magenta energy, each facet internally illuminated by shifting cuneiform symbols—the player’s VR-gloved hand activates Vinyl Crackle mode, saturating the air with visible soundwaves that warp the cathedral reverb’s ghostly choir into warped 8-bit echoes as the skeletal UI frame’s gold ribs contract like a breathing organism, its terminal readout flashing "DECORATION ACTIVE: BIT CRUSHER" in stuttering glyphs that drip liquid shadow.
